trust_decision.summary: Any request carrying a Utm-Internal-Key header equal to env INTERNAL_KEY is authenticated as the first active admin user on every route; the decision is made only in InternalApiKeyFilter, with no path, method or source restriction.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names InternalApiKeyFilter; the whole trust decision is this one equals() branch.

fix_sites.entry_point: every /api/** HTTP route (servlet filter before JWTFilter); fix.diff:72-86 adds a path allowlist, fix.diff:99-117 gates auth on it, plus constant-time compare and optional CIDR check
GET /api/v1/mode (fix.diff:13 permitAll); separate federation commit, related to unauthenticated access but not the internal-key decision

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The CVE-2026-82042 part of the fix touches only InternalApiKeyFilter.java (fix.diff:22-217); the other files in 4e7a727c belong to sibling CVEs 82039-82045.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 route: the static apiKeyHeaderInUse flag is a thread-safety/race issue in a resource method, not the authentication filter the advisory names, and the published fix keeps it static (fix.diff:63).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate internal callers send Utm-Internal-Key to routes outside the published allowlist: rule-flood-guard (/api/correlation-rule/search-by-filters, /activate-deactivate, /api/notifications), compliance-orchestrator (/api/compliance/control-config, /api/utm-index-patterns), and headless PDF rendering of compliance reports where the frontend attaches the key to every API call. An over-narrow allowlist (including the published one) breaks these; an over-broad fix (dropping key auth) breaks module-details-decrypted for agent-manager/plugins.

O6_input_shapes: path with query string (stripped by using getRequestURI, fix.diff:128-134)
path under a servlet context path (fix.diff:138-142)
header value compared in constant time (fix.diff:99-101)
optional source IP via X-Forwarded-For or remote addr against INTERNAL_KEY_ALLOWED_CIDRS (fix.diff:155-183)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: module-details-decrypted gates secret disclosure on a JVM-wide static Boolean set by whichever request last passed the filter, not on the current request's authentication
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like a concurrency bug in a resource handler rather than the filter bypass; the published fix leaves the flag static (fix.diff:63, fix.diff:123-125).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (web.rest.application_modules vs security.internalApiKey); flag defined at backend/src/main/java/com/park/utmstack/security/internalApiKey/InternalApiKeyFilter.java:22 and set at :34/:45

O8b_injection_room.sibling: WebSocket handshake determineUser also accepting ?key=<INTERNAL_KEY> and returning the internal admin authentication with no route scoping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The headless PDF flow already passes the internal key as ?key= to the frontend (web-pdf/src/main/java/com/utmstack/webtopdf/config/enums/AccessType.java:10), so a maintainer could add key support to /ws for live dashboards in reports; it is a second implementation at distance from the filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: user API-key filter falling back to INTERNAL_KEY comparison and granting internal admin auth on any path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same filter chain, adjacent header-based auth; a fallback for plugins that send the key in the API-key header is a plausible convenience change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: path-identity differential: allowlist checked on raw getRequestURI while MVC dispatch uses a normalized/decoded path (case, encoded chars, suffix patterns)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A how-type sibling; the published requestPath helper already hand-normalizes the URI, so a variant normalization mismatch is realistic.

O9_family: authentication bypass / over-privileged shared machine key (CWE-306, A07)

O10_build.language: Java 17 (backend), plus Go services and Angular frontend in the monorepo
O10_build.toolchain: Maven (backend/pom.xml; jhipster-dependencies 7.3.1); spring-boot.version property is 3.1.5 but code uses javax.servlet and WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter, actual Boot version unknown
O10_build.project_tests: No backend tests found under backend/src/test; the filter can be exercised with a unit/MockMvc test using mock requests and a stubbed InternalApiKeyProvider.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a path allowlist in InternalApiKeyFilter from the obvious callers (soc-ai, feeds, modules-config) and stop, leaving the static apiKeyHeaderInUse flag and other internal callers unconsidered.

out_of_scope_notes: Commit 4e7a727c bundles 7 CVEs: SSRF in IdentityProviderService and PdfService, SQL injection in UtmAssetGroupService and UtmNetworkScanService, account enumeration in AccountResource, missing admin check in UTMIncidentCommandWebsocket; none are part of CVE-2026-82042.

Go services verify the internal key without route scoping and with non-constant-time compare: plugins/modules-config/middleware.go:26, plugins/modules-config/middleware.go:59, plugins/inputs/middlewares.go:121-125 (separate sinks; agent-manager already scopes by route at agent-manager/agent/interceptor.go:61-69).
The frontend stores the internal key from the PDF ?key= parameter in browser storage (frontend/src/app/blocks/interceptor/auth.interceptor.ts:23-25).
